comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
6-item Memorial Album revolving Port Royal-exclusive TH, 19th Century TH, and B.C TH related to Babylon, one of the Seven Wonders that is currently introduced (yes i'm looking at you Lost Memories expansion)

Contains :
Sword of the Lioness of Brittany - Need 17th Century P4 title, and people haven't mention that this Legendary honorable thief and pirate TH will show ONLY if you already discover Port Royal.

Honorable Thief's Longbow - Same like above.

The Surprising Adventures of the Bragging Baron - Need 19th Century title, and possibly San Fransisco discovered is must for Bizarre Rumours TH to show.

St. Germain's Secret Book - Same like above.

Cylinder of Nebuchadnezzar II - Need B.C title, comes from The Lost City

Mul Apin Tablet - Same like above.

Reward for completion : Ivory Sea Clock which is not bad boost for adventurers.
